privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_policy.1_introduction: Asoebi.Africa is committed to protecting your personal data in compliance with the Nigeria Data Protection Regulation (NDPR). This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and safeguard your personal information when you use our Platform.
3_purpose_of_data_collection: To create and manage user accounts
To process transactions and deliver purchased products or services
To improve the functionality and performance of our platform

4_legal_basis_for_processing.consent: For optional services and marketing communications
4_legal_basis_for_processing.contract: To fulfill our obligations in any agreement with you
4_legal_basis_for_processing.legal_obligation: Where processing is necessary for compliance with laws
4_legal_basis_for_processing.legitimate_interest: For platform security, fraud prevention, and service improvement

5_data_sharing_and_disclosure.vendors_and_service_providers: For payment processing, logistics, analytics, and customer support
5_data_sharing_and_disclosure.third_party_sellers: Where necessary to fulfill your orders
5_data_sharing_and_disclosure.law_enforcement: When required by law or to protect our legal rights
5_data_sharing_and_disclosure.note: We do not sell your personal information to third parties

privacy_policy.6_data_retention: We retain your personal data only as long as necessary for the purposes set out in this policy or to comply with legal obligations. After this period, your data will be securely deleted or anonymized.

7_data_subject_rights.right_to_access: You can request a copy of your personal data
7_data_subject_rights.right_to_rectification: You can request correction of inaccurate data
7_data_subject_rights.right_to_erasure: You can request deletion of your personal data
7_data_subject_rights.right_to_data_portability: You can request your data in a machine-readable format
7_data_subject_rights.right_to_object: You can object to certain types of data processing

privacy_policy.8_cookies_and_tracking_technologies: Our app uses cookies and similar technologies to enhance user experience and collect analytical data. You can control cookie preferences through your device or browser settings.
privacy_policy.9_data_security: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
privacy_policy.10_cross_border_data_transfers: If your personal data is transferred outside Nigeria, we ensure that appropriate safeguards are in place, including adequate data protection agreements in accordance with NDPR requirements.
privacy_policy.11_childrens_privacy: Our platform is not intended for children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe we have collected such data, please contact us for immediate removal.
privacy_policy.12_changes_to_this_privacy_policy: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be communicated via app notifications or email. Continued use of the platform implies acceptance of the updated policy.
